description: List your iCloud calendars (event calendars only): id, name, color, whether you can add events to it, whether it is shared (shared: with you by someone else; sharedByYou: by you with others), and which one new events go into by default. Use the name or id with the other apple_calendar_* tools. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME and ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (an app-specific password).
name: apple_calendar_list_calendars
title: List your iCloud calendars
